en-US.description: OSINT CLI with entity-graph, auto-pivot, smart shell, active recon and AI explain
en-US.longDescription:
mytools-osint v4.2 is a personal-use OSINT toolkit:
 * 45 modules across passive (Shodan InternetDB, crt.sh, CertSpotter, RIPEstat, HackerTarget, Wayback CDX, threat-intel) and active recon (route_discover, port_scan, WAF/CMS/GraphQL fingerprinting, favicon hash, subdomain takeover).
 * v4.0 entity graph (19 entity types, 33 edge types) + bounded BFS auto-pivot.
 * v4.2 single-fire interactive shell (q/i/l/m fire instantly), 7 themes (dracula, nord, tokyo-night, catppuccin-mocha, etc.).
 * SIEM exporters (Splunk HEC, Elasticsearch, syslog, MISP).
 * Optional AI explain (Claude haiku/sonnet, disabled in --opsec mode).
 * Free APIs only, no paid keys required.
 * Authorised security testing only.
en-US.name: mytools-osint
